workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: Each unit member shall have at least a 30 minute duty-free, uninter- rupted lunch period exclusive of passing periods.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: In general, unit members shall be required to attend staff meetings, faculty meetings, department meetings, site functions, student supervision, and other administratively-called meetings no more than two hours per month

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Unit members shall not be required to supervise students during routine daily student arrivals/departures, or recesses/non instructional breaks (before, during, or after school).
